extends SceneTree
## Step 45: writes a save fixture the way this checkout's own build wrote it
## (app/main.gd save_now: schema 1 envelope, JSON.stringify). Run inside a detached
## worktree of an old version. EXP=stand|factory OUT=<file> MINUTES=<n> FORTY=1
func _init() -> void:
	var exp := OS.get_environment("EXP")
	var out := OS.get_environment("OUT")
	var minutes := int(OS.get_environment("MINUTES"))
	var rules: PopRules
	if OS.get_environment("FORTY") == "1":
		var T = load("res://tests/unit/test_factory_rules.gd").new()
		rules = T._forty(44, 81)
	else:
		rules = PopRegistry.make_rules(exp, null)
	var ms := 0
	var pops := 0
	while ms < minutes * 60000:
		if not bool(rules.heating) and int(rules.cooldown_left) <= 0 and (not ("glass" in rules) or (rules.get("glass") as Dictionary).is_empty()):
			if bool(rules.execute({"type": "press"})["ok"]):
				var w := int(rules.window_start()) + 30
				rules.advance(w)
				ms += w
				rules.execute({"type": "release"})
				pops += 1
		rules.execute({"type": "buy"})
		if rules.has_method("auto_offer"):
			rules.execute({"type": "buy_auto"})
		rules.advance(1500)
		ms += 1500
	var ver := String(ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/version"))
	var doc := {"schema": 1, "game": "popcorn-glory", "exp": exp, "version": ver, "active_ms": ms, "rules": rules.call("to_save")}
	var f := FileAccess.open(out, FileAccess.WRITE)
	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(doc))
	f.close()
	print("fixture %s %s: %d ms, %d pops, level %d, money %d, bytes %d" % [exp, ver, ms, pops, int(rules.level), int(rules.money), JSON.stringify(doc).length()])
	quit(0)
